Description

David Ross Estate Agents, your local property experts, are proud to present new to the market for sale No.60 Liscarne Gardens. This fine 3 bedroom property comes to the market bound to catch the eye of any discerning purchaser.

Located in the heart of Clondalkin, number 60 is surrounded by a host of local amenities to include great sports facilities, primary and secondary schools. Liffey Valley Shopping Centre is only a stones throw away which is ideal for shops, cafes and restaurants and many more. 

Upon entering this property you are immediately met with a bright and open entrance hallway. Just off this you have a good sized reception room with plenty of natural light coming in through the window, a classic feature fireplace completes this space. Moving through the property you will find an open plan kitchen/dining area. This space has plenty of potential to be a fine entertaining space.

To the rear of the property you have a sunny and private South facing back garden, a relaxing space to spend those long summer evenings.

Upstairs briefly comprises a double bedroom alongside a family bathroom to the rear and a double alongside a single bedroom to the front aspect.

This area benefits from fantastic public transport links with several bus routes running through the area. The M50 motorway is also only a short drive away.

Early viewing would be recommended to see everything this property has to offer.
Viewing by appointment only.

Features:
- Off street parking
- Extended
- South facing back garden
- Open plan kitchen/dining
- Local amenities
